context.title: Context
context.hint: Data from IRemoteComponentContext, passed by the host when initializing the control.

logger.title: Logging
logger.hint: Logging via context.logger. The logger name is set via WORKAROUND-04 — forced write to the name property, not exposed by the ILogger interface.

settings.title: getSettings
settings.hint: Asynchronous retrieval of component settings via api.getSettings(). Settings are read from config.yaml.

getEntity.title: getEntity
getEntity.hint: Retrieving the card entity via api.getEntity<T>(). Returns a proxy object.

lockInfo.title: LockInfo
lockInfo.hint: Entity lock information: entity.LockInfo. An entity locked by another user cannot be edited.

state.title: State
state.hint: Entity state: entity.State. Contains the enabled flag and the state of each property.

info.title: Info
info.hint: Entity property metadata: entity.Info.properties. Name, type, display value.

changeProperty.title: changeProperty
changeProperty.hint: Changing a property via proxy: entity.changeProperty(name, value). Checks property availability and lock status.

executeAction.title: executeAction / canExecuteAction
executeAction.hint: Executing an entity action. canExecuteAction checks availability before execution.

onControlUpdate.title: onControlUpdate
onControlUpdate.hint: Callback invoked by the host when the card changes. The control must update the entity and context.

ui.title: Modals, tooltips, toasts
ui.hint: Modal: Portal + focus. Tooltip: getBoundingClientRect + Portal + scroll tracking. Toasts: Portal stack with auto-dismiss.
ui.tooltipText: This is a tooltip rendered via Portal. It tracks trigger position on resize and scroll.

errorHandling.title: Error handling
errorHandling.hint: ErrorBoundary for render errors. Async errors require try/catch + context.logger.error(). All errors must be logged.

childCollection.title: Child collections
childCollection.hint: IChildEntityCollection methods: addNew, remove, forEach, filter, find, map, sort. Select a collection property below.

localStorage.title: localStorage
localStorage.hint: Safe localStorage access with tenant + control name prefix. Without prefix, keys will mix between different apps.

advice.context: `context` comes from the host and is read-only. Do not modify its fields — changes will not apply and will not be visible to the host.
advice.logger: Use `context.logger` instead of `console.log`. Set the logger name via `setLoggerName(context.logger, 'MyComponent')` — this is WORKAROUND-04: ILogger doesn't expose name, we write to it directly.
advice.settings: Never read `window`, `window.parent` or `document.cookie` to get settings. The only legitimate way is `api.getSettings()`.
advice.getEntity: `entity` is a proxy object. Do not assign properties directly (`entity.Subject = '...'`). Always use `entity.changeProperty()`. Lazy init: `useState(() => api.getEntity())` — the function runs once on first render.
advice.lockInfo: Always check `LockInfo` before allowing the user to edit. If `IsLocked && !IsLockedByMe && !IsLockedHere` — the entity is locked by another client.
advice.state: Check the entity's `IsEnabled` and each property's `IsEnabled`/`IsVisible`. A property may be visible but not editable.
advice.info: Use `Info.properties` to dynamically bind UI to entity metadata. The property name from `controlInfo.propertyName` can always be found in this array.
advice.changeProperty: Only `entity.changeProperty(name, value)`. Direct mutation (`entity[prop] = val`) bypasses the proxy interceptor and never reaches the server.
advice.executeAction: Always check `canExecuteAction(actionName)` before calling `executeAction`. If the action is unavailable — the host will return an error.
advice.onControlUpdate: Always call `api.getEntity()` again inside the callback. The old `entity` reference may point to stale data.
advice.ui: Portal + CSS Modules + `--theme_*` = safe and isolated UI. Do not write global styles, do not inject DOM directly into the host container.
advice.errorHandling: All errors must be logged via `context.logger.error()`. ErrorBoundary catches only render errors — async errors (`Promise`, `setTimeout`) pass through and require `try/catch`.
advice.childCollection: All child entity operations go through the collection methods. Do not mutate the array directly. `addNew` and `remove` are async — refresh entity via `api.getEntity()` after.
advice.localStorage: Always prefix keys with `tenant` + control name. Without prefix, keys from different controls and apps under the same tenant will mix. Never read `window.localStorage` directly — use a prefix helper.

nonStandardAction.title: Non-standard action — no CanExecute support
nonStandardAction.description: Save and similar built-in actions do not support canExecuteAction. The check is skipped. For all other actions, checking canExecuteAction is mandatory — otherwise the host may reject execution due to access rights or entity state.

warnings.versionReadOnly: The {{collectionName}} collection is managed by the host — adding and removing items is not available from a Remote Component. API methods are shown for reference, but mutations are disabled.

errors.noCollection: This entity has no child collections. Section is disabled.
errors.noEditableProperty: No editable properties found. Properties are either missing from State or disabled. Section is disabled.
errors.proxyNote: Child entity properties are not accessible via reflection — they are host proxy objects. Correct approach: static TypeScript interface + direct property access. Example: src/controls/performed-work-details-grid/

modal.title: Demo window
modal.portal: This window is rendered via Portal to document.body — it is not in the control's DOM tree.
modal.cssModules: All classes come from CSS Modules — they are hashed and do not conflict with the host.
modal.theme: Colors and fonts use the host's --theme_* variables — the window inherits the host theme.
modal.escape: When opened: body scroll is locked, Escape key closes the window.
modal.focus: When closed: focus returns to the element that was active before opening.
modal.stopPropagation: stopPropagation on content prevents closing when clicking inside the window.

actionsMetadata.title: getActionsMetadata
actionsMetadata.hint: Getting the list of cover actions via api.getActionsMetadata(). Returns an array of {id, title, description}.

coverExecuteAction.title: executeAction (Guid)
coverExecuteAction.hint: Executing a cover action by Guid identifier via api.executeAction(id). Unlike card API, there is no canExecuteAction method.

onControlUpdate.hint: Callback invoked by the host when the cover changes from another control. The cover has no entity — the handler updates only the context.

advice.actionsMetadata: `api.getActionsMetadata()` returns the current list of available actions. Use it for dynamic UI — don't hardcode identifiers.
advice.coverExecuteAction: In Cover API, actions are called by `Guid`. Get the ID from `getActionsMetadata()`. Without `canExecuteAction` — the host itself returns an error.
advice.onControlUpdate: Inside the callback, update `setContext()`. The cover has no entity — `getEntity()` is not available. `getActionsMetadata()` is synchronous, no re-fetch needed.
